## Kind of change

- [ ] Code, docs, or tooling — 1 maintainer approval
- [ ] **Criteria** — adds, removes, or restatuses a layer. Needs a proposal, 2 approvals, 72 hours open

## For a verifier or criteria change

- [ ] `./bypasses/run.sh <platform>` passes
- [ ] New bypass cases added for anything this change is meant to catch
- [ ] Effect on existing registry entries checked, and stated below
